name: host-member-turn-failed-then-ended
description: Rule 53's order (coordinator decision 7, 2026-09-26): a reader admits a failed turn's turn_failed bounces followed by the member's member_ended with no member_idle between. A member that fails a turn and then ends never became idle, and demanding member_idle in between would force both runtimes to emit a transition that did not happen. This pins the readers, not the writer: an append that ends the member skips rule 53's bounces and bounces member_ended instead (host-member-end-bounces-taken-ask), so no writer produces this order. An ask a turn_failed bounce answered is not bounced again.
